description: Land Title Settlement Department   -   Amendment to  the  Gaz. Ex. No. 1839/19 of  04.12.2013  - Cad. Map No.521202 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing changes to ownership types, owner names, and national identity card numbers for specific parcels of land. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land title amendments, which aligns perfectly with the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
